identity.title: An engineered probiotic with integrated biocomputation and multi-molecular recording for precision theranostics of colitis.

content.abstract: Engineered therapeutic microbes capable of sensing and responding to diseases offer transformative potential for precision medicine. However, their capacity to intelligently process the complex and dynamic biomarkers of multifaceted diseases such as inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) remains limited. Here, we design a probiotic system that executes logic computations through four stage-specific inflammatory biomarkers, enabling precise diagnosis and closed-loop treatment of colitis in mice. Integration with a CRISPR-based molecular recorder allows dynamic tracking of biomarker levels and converts inflammatory signals into quantifiable, site-specific base-editing events, thereby achieving precise diagnosis and analysis of disease progression within a living mammalian gut. We additionally develop a multimodal machine-learning classifier that utilizes both bioluminescent reporter signals and sequencing data to accurately stage intestinal inflammation with an accuracy of 0.83 +/- 0.05. Together, this work provides a robust platform for in situ biocomputation and marks a significant advance toward intelligent, precision theranostics for gastrointestinal disorders.
